name: Being A Part Of The Family Of God
overview: Scripture reveals that becoming part of the family of God is granted to those who receive Christ and believe in His name, giving them the privilege to be called His children (John 1:12). Believers are united as one body in Christ, intimately connected as members of one another (Romans 12:5). This family relationship is established through God's sovereign will, predestining believers for adoption as His children through Jesus Christ (Ephesians 1:5). As members of this household, Christians are no longer strangers but fellow citizens with the saints, called to care especially for one another within the family of faith (Ephesians 2:19; Galatians 6:10).
